technical_summary: Customer needs a multi-region reserved GPU strategy: primary pool in eu-west with 8xA100 reserved, secondary pool in us-east with 6xA100 reserved for failover headroom (able to sustain 2x baseline for 15 minutes). Want canary routing + automatic fallback to secondary region when p95 latency or healthy-node thresholds breach. Require explicit SLOs: 99.95% availability for dedicated endpoints, p95 latency <75ms; want quantitative cost model that shows reserve vs burst pricing and a proposed SLA with credit schedule for latency violations.
